properties.name: variant
properties.description:
App bar size variant.

- `small` — 64px action row with inline title-large headline.
- `medium` — flexible 112px (136px with subtitle) expanded headline block.
- `large` — flexible 120px (152px with subtitle) expanded headline block.
- `search` — 64px row with inline search field (M3 search app bar).

properties.name: titleAlignment
properties.description:
Title horizontal alignment — `start` (leading edge, default) or `center`.
On search bars it centers the placeholder when empty and unfocused; once
focused or when typing, the caret and text align to the inline-start edge.

properties.name: searchPlaceholder
properties.description:
Search variant only: hinted search text shown in the inline search field.
Falls back to `placeholder` on the optional `search` slot when empty.

properties.name: searchValue
properties.description: Search variant only: current search field value (two-way bindable).

properties.name: searchAriaLabel
properties.description:
Search variant only: accessible name for the inline search field. Per M3
labeling guidance, falls back to `search-placeholder` when unset.

properties.name: searchDisabled
properties.description: Search variant only: disable the inline search field.

properties.name: headline
properties.description: Inline or expanded headline text. Falls back to the `headline` slot when empty.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description:
Optional subtitle. On flexible variants it sits below the expanded headline
(and grows the container); on `small` it stacks under the inline title.
Falls back to the `subtitle` slot when empty.

properties.name: scrolled
density
properties.description:
Density scale: 0 (default 64px row), -1 (60px), -2 (56px), -3 (52px), -4 (48px).
Tightens the action row, icon targets, search field, and expanded heights.

properties.name: leadingIcon
properties.description: Material Symbols name for the leading navigation icon (slot takes priority).

properties.name: leadingIconLabel
properties.description: Accessible label for the prop-based leading icon button. Required when `leading-icon` is set.

slots.name: search-trailing
slots.description: In-pill trailing icons (e.g. mic); data-compact-keep opts out of compact hide

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Leading navigation icon(s) — slot takes priority over leading-icon prop

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Trailing action icons outside search field (max 3; excess hidden + warn)

cssParts.name: subtitle
cssParts.description: Subtitle text (inline on small, expanded on medium/large)

cssParts.name: search-state-layer
cssParts.description: Hover / focus / press overlay on search field

cssParts.name: search-field
cssParts.description: Text/input flex region inside pill (hint padding)

cssParts.name: search-trailing
cssParts.description: Trailing slot inside the search field

cssParts.name: state-layer
cssParts.description: Leading icon state layer (exported from leading-icon)

cssProperties.name: --md-app-bar-row-padding-block-start
cssProperties.description: Action row block-start padding (20px large expanded)

cssProperties.name: --md-app-bar-trailing-icon-touch-size
cssProperties.description: Trailing icon touch target (48px; matches leading)

cssProperties.name: --md-app-bar-icon-gap
cssProperties.description: Gap between icons and row content (0)

cssProperties.name: --md-app-bar-icon-size
cssProperties.description: Icon glyph size in action row (24px,

attributes.name: class
attributes.value:
{
          'md-app-bar': true,
          [`md-app-bar--${this.variant}`]: true,
          'md-app-bar--flexible': flexible,
          'md-app-bar--center': centered,
          'md-app-bar--search': search,
          'md-app-bar--with-subtitle': !search && this.hasSubtitleContent(),
          'md-app-bar--search-focused': search && this.searchFocused,
          'md-app-bar--search-disabled': search && this.searchDisabled,
          'md-app-bar--with-search-trailing': search && this.hasSlottedSearchTrailing,
          'md-app-bar--scrolled': this.scrolled,
          [`md-app-bar--density${this.density}`]: this.density !== 0,
        }

name: App Bar
description: The screen's header. Title, a leading navigation affordance, and trailing actions — in small / medium / large heights, plus a dedicated search variant for apps where search is the primary global function.

notes: Dedicated native app bar (SwiftUI / Compose): small, medium and large bars (the expanded headline block below the row, start or centred), the search bar (pill, in-pill actions, slotted search content), the leading icon button (mdLeadingClick), the trailing actions (at most three shown, one warning per new excess), scrolled colours with their transitions, density and the spacing rung.

The search input as the source: focus activates (mdSearchActivate), typing emits mdSearchInput (Space announces activation first), Enter activates, Home / End move the caret, keyboard focus selects the text and shows the ring; the pill's hover / press state layer, ripple and focus ring.

The 38 hooks (the stylesheet's list; the CEM lists 32) through .awcAppBarAppearance(…) / AWCAppBarAppearanceScope as CSS text; every exported part through the typed part appearances (.awcAppBarPartAppearance(_:part:) / AWCAppBarPartAppearanceScope).

macOS SwiftUI, the iOS simulator and the Android emulator are verified against Mac Chrome 153: paint and geometry of every configuration (small, centred, medium, large and search bars, subtitles, slots, the trailing cap, density, RTL, dark, the hooks and every typed part), the interaction states and motion (scrolled colours, the search pill's hover / press layer, ripple and focus ring, the input's focus, selection, typing and the events) and the Laboratory hooks and updates.
